infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Freshness Tracker uses the camera to scan food labels.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Freshness Tracker reads photos so you can scan a food label from your library.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Freshness Tracker talks to the freshness API running on your computer over Wi-Fi.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Freshness Tracker to access your photos to scan food labels.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Freshness Tracker to use the camera to scan food labels.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Freshness Tracker to use the microphone for voice questions.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow Freshness Tracker to transcribe voice questions for the assistant.
